title: Script GC forward barrier
summary: Recover the forward barrier at 0x4f2560: phase 1 passes the child to the marker; other phases recolor the parent with current white bits. The original has a hybrid ECX/EDX and caller-popped stack ABI, represented by a portable member interface and an explicit marker integration dependency.
test_description: Differential comparisons of every parent mark and current-white byte across phases 0, 1, 2 and 255, varied child marks and marker types 0, 3, 11 and 255, plus parent-child aliasing. Entire fixture comparisons check untouched bytes. The phase-1 test invokes the accepted original marker through the integration adapter and checks its effect on child mark bits; FS setup and restoration are checked.
known_limits: The marker is an external integration dependency and its full traversal is outside this recovered scope. Phase-1 tests use marker types outside 4 through 10, which return before the marker's external jump table; graph traversal and linked gray-list cases are not tested.
Layouts describe observed 32-bit fields only. Inputs must supply valid state, global and relevant object pointers as the original does.
Portable member interface does not reproduce the original hybrid register and caller-cleanup ABI; a platform integration adapter is required. No matching-byte claim is made.
